objectives.statement: Recognize common adverbs of time, frequency, degree, manner, and place.
Place common frequency adverbs after the finite verb in simple main clauses.
Use degree adverbs before adjectives or adverbs, and manner adverbs to describe how something happens.
Put time and place adverbs at the end or front of a main clause, with the finite verb second when fronted.

notes: Must teach time adverbs (ofte, alltid, aldri, snart, nå), frequency adverbs, degree adverbs (veldig, ganske, litt), manner adverbs (bra, forsiktig), and place adverbs (her, der, hit, dit) with their basic placement in the clause. Defer sentence-adverb ikke-placement to its own lesson (ikke_and_sentence_adverb_placement at B1) and defer comparison of adverbs to adverb_comparison.
